### findConflicts

```ts
findConflicts: (id, hotkey, recordedWith?) => AppHotkey<string, HotkeyChord | HotkeySequence | null>[];
```

Defined in: [useAppHotkeys.ts:90](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/vue-hotkeys/src/useAppHotkeys.ts#L90)

Other app hotkeys that would collide if `id` used `hotkey`. Pass the
recorder's `context` for a recorded hotkey: it has the key press, which
also finds a hotkey written differently that the same press fires.

### setCustomHotkey

```ts
setCustomHotkey: (id, hotkey, recordedWith?) => AppHotkey<string, HotkeyChord | HotkeySequence | null>[];
```

Defined in: [useAppHotkeys.ts:76](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/vue-hotkeys/src/useAppHotkeys.ts#L76)

Sets the user's hotkey for an app hotkey. `null` unbinds it.
Returns conflicting app hotkeys; when any exist, nothing changes. Pass
the recorder's `context` for a recorded hotkey, as for `findConflicts`.

#### Parameters

##### id

`string`

##### hotkey

`Hotkey` \| `null`

##### recordedWith?

`RecordedKeyPresses`
